sloka: ब्राह्मणानाम् सहस्राणि तैः एवम् काम रूपिभिः ।विनाशितानि संहत्य नित्यशः पिशित अशनैः ॥३-११-६०॥
transliteration: brāhmaṇānām sahasrāṇi taiḥ evam kāma rūpibhiḥ ।vināśitāni saṁhatya nityaśaḥ piśita aśanaiḥ ॥3-11-60॥

translations.english: Then hearing his brother's voice, Vatapi would bleat like a sheep and jump out, tearing open the bodies of those brahmins.
